title: MissingReferenceException: The object of type 'UnityEngine.MeshRenderer' has been destroyed but you are still trying to
notes: Fix 2026-11-24 by claude (a5a7ef89c3): The Jacks net is a scene-root object made in Awake, so it could be destroyed while the hull lived on; NetMesh.Draw then threw every LateUpdate. JacksBodies.DrawNet now rebuilds the net when its renderer is gone. Cause inferred from the code, compiled with unity_refcompile, not run in the editor: the clean play tests are the proof.
